integrity.computational_basis: A standalone standard-library script checks 99 exact rational parameter points and the base Jacobian determinant.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytical best-response derivation and exact cube-root equilibrium formula.
integrity.provenance: Original mathematical construction; no authorship or independent-certification claim.

scientific_limitations: The result is an explicit counterexample to the regularity sufficiency statement in Theorem 3 of the cited 2026 article.
It does not refute equilibrium existence or upper-hemicontinuity claims in that article.
The game is a complete-information special case; the non-Lipschitz result is proved analytically, while the finite script checks are supplementary.
No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
title: A cube-root equilibrium branch refutes strict-concavity-only smoothness
